You can craft small explosives called charges. During a short or long rest, you produce a number of them equal to your Intelligence modifier, provided you have a demolitions kit on hand. Only you can use your own charges, and any you haven't used lose their potency at the end of your next short or long rest.

Once per turn, in place of a ranged weapon attack, you may hurl one of your charges at a point you can see within range — 30 feet plus five times your Strength modifier. Every creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier) or take 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier kinetic damage, taking half as much on a success.

This damage rises to 3d4 at 7th level and 4d4 at 15th level.
